# Rule: restrict added to the definition only

_Canonical rule slug:_ `restrict-added-to-definition-only`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> An implementation gains `restrict` on its parameters while the declaration in the public header is untouched, so the contract consumers compile against is unchanged.
